Introduction , first reading, and consideration of a motion to order published by title only Ordinance 8539 submitting to the registered electors of the City of Boulder at the Special Municipal Coordinated Election to be held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, the question of whether to amend Sections 65, 102 and 130 and repeal Sections 69, 132, 133, and 134 from the Boulder Home Rule Charter and shall any funds remaining in the Library Fund be repurposed if the initiative to create a library district on the Boulder County Ballot is approved at this election; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details - REMOVED

Introduction , first reading, and consideration of a motion to order published by title only Ordinance 8541 submitting to the registered electors of the City of Boulder at the Special Municipal Coordinated Election to be held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, the question of whether to amend Sections 5, 9, 14 and 22 of the Boulder Home Rule Charter to change the regular municipal election to even-numbered years rather than odd-numbered years starting in 2024; change the date for direct election of the mayor to 2026; implement the transition by extending the terms of all nine existing council members for one year; skip the candidate election in 2023; related procedures; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details – REMOVED
